senses.sense_definition: Een pittige saus of smaakmaker op basis van fijngewreven hete Spaanse pepers.

examples.text: Hij doet altijd een flinke lepel <w>sambal</w> bij zijn nasi.

target_lang_translations.en: He always puts a generous spoonful of <w>sambal</w> with his fried rice.
target_lang_translations.tr: Kızarmış pilavına her zaman koca bir kaşık <w>sambal</w> koyar.

examples.text: Pas op met die <w>sambal</w>, want hij smaakt ontzettend scherp.

target_lang_translations.en: Be careful with that <w>chili paste</w>, because it tastes extremely hot.
target_lang_translations.tr: O <w>acı sosa</w> dikkat et, çünkü tadı inanılmaz derecede acı.

target_lang_definitions.en: A spicy sauce or condiment based on ground hot chili peppers.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Ezilmiş acı biberlerden yapılan Endonezya kökenli acı bir sos veya çeşni.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Indonesian/Southeast Asian chili paste or sauce
general condiment made from ground peppers

senses.sense_definition: Een pittig bijgerecht bereid met chilipepers en vlees of gevogelte, vaak met orgaanvlees zoals lever.

examples.text: In de toko verkopen ze heerlijke <w>sambal</w> gemaakt van kippenlevertjes.

target_lang_translations.en: At the Asian grocery store, they sell delicious <w>sambal</w> made from chicken livers.
target_lang_translations.tr: Asya marketinde tavuk ciğerinden yapılmış nefis bir <w>sambal</w> satıyorlar.

examples.text: Mijn grootmoeder bereidt deze traditionele <w>sambal</w> altijd volgens een oud familierecept.

target_lang_translations.en: My grandmother always prepares this traditional <w>sambal dish</w> according to an old family recipe.
target_lang_translations.tr: Büyükannem bu geleneksel <w>sambalı</w> her zaman eski bir aile tarifine göre hazırlar.

target_lang_definitions.en: A spicy side dish prepared with chili peppers and meat or poultry, often including organ meats such as liver.
target_lang_definitions.tr: Genellikle karaciğer gibi sakatatlar, et veya kümes hayvanlarıyla acı biberler kullanılarak pişirilen Endonezya usulü baharatlı bir yemek veya garnitür (sambal goreng).

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Indonesian spicy side dish often made with meat or poultry
fried spicy chili dish, e.g. with liver or tofu
